CROPS, ONE GROVE

About the Grove

One ecosystem, grown on purpose

Patrine didn’t set out to keep bees — she planted passion fruit first. The bees came for the flowers and stayed for good, and now the two feed each other: the hives pollinate the vines, the vines feed the hives, and both end up on your table. Nothing here is grown apart from the rest.

Pollination

The Vines

Ripening

Left on the vine until it’s ready, not until it’s convenient.

The Harvest

Fruit picked by hand, honey drawn frame by frame.

Meet Patrine

The hands behind the grove

Patrine started with a handful of passion fruit vines and has spent years turning them into a small, working ecosystem — fruit, bees, and honey, all on one plot. She still does most of the hands-on work herself: pruning, harvesting, and checking each hive.

This grove is her craft, and she’s building a place online where people can see it for what it is.

Patrine — Founder, Patrine’s Grove
